mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it triggers market anticipation of aggressive monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer and business confidence, elevating corporate earnings expectations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), CPIAUCSL above 2.5% per annum signals persistent inflation, leading to sustained high rates that depress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 3-month moving average signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below its 3-month moving average, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based economic strength, elevating corporate earnings growth expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, a persistently high unemployment rate (above 8.5%) signals weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5% during post-recession recovery, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
